children: ROMANEL-SUR-MORGES (dpa-AFX) - Logitech International SA (LOGN.SW) announced earnings for its second quarter that Increases, from last year
The company's bottom line came in at $180.035 million, or $1.25 per share.  This compares with $170.670 million, or $1.15 per share, last year.
Excluding items, Logitech International SA reported adjusted earnings of $216.662 million or $1.51 per share for the period.
The company's revenue for the period rose 2.7% to $1.218 billion from $1.186 billion last year.
